title: Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I ('Tubercular Expectoration (I)')

date.basis: MK: 'completed on 8 Rajab 829/16 May 1426 in Herat' (no asterisk). The Majlis colophon may record copying (MK's first-half caveat, pdf p.96); the same standard as WRK-MAFAHIS.

occasion: Written in answer to the accusations of Ibn Turka's enemies in Yazd brought before Shāhrukh's court in Herat.
manuscript: 5 items listed: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 179b-83b (Herat, 8 Rajab 829/16 May 1426); MS 5423 (842/1439); MS 10004/12 (903-4/1497-98, with critical marginalia); MS 3035/2 (1084/1673); Tehran microfilm 830.
summary: An apology in an autobiographical introduction, a commentary on nine hadith condemning bidʿa, and a commentary on the sayings of Sufi masters in support of Sufi orthodoxy; a companion to the Iʿtiqādāt.
